description_en: Installs one or more Cloud Backup clients on specified instances
description_zh: 在指定实例上安装一个或多个HBR备份客户端
name: CreateClients

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The alert settings. Valid value: INHERITED, which indicates that the HBR client sends alert notifications by using the same method configured for the backup vault
parameters.help_zh: 告警设置。取值为INHERITED，表示使用与备份库一致的报警方式
parameters.name: alert_setting

parameters.help_en: The installation information of the HBR clients
parameters.name: client_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to transmit data over HTTPS. Valid values:

true: transmits data over HTTPS.
false: transmits data over HTTP
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用HTTPS传输数据。

true：使用HTTPS传输。
false：使用HTTP传输
parameters.name: use_https

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The backup type. Valid values:

SELF_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up within the same Alibaba Cloud account.
CROSS_ACCOUNT: Data is backed up across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持：
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source Alibaba Cloud account that authorizes the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role that is created within the source Alibaba Cloud account and assigned to the current Alibaba Cloud account to authorize the current Alibaba Cloud account to back up data across Alibaba Cloud accounts
parameters.help_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The status code 200 indicates that the call is successful

Message.description_en: The message that is returned. If the call is successful, "successful" is returned. If the call fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous job. You can call the DescribeTask operation to query the execution result of an asynchronous job
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID。可以通过调用DescribeTask获取任务结果
